# Research data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `python -m app.cli research-dictionary`; do not edit by hand. -->

The research export (Plan §5.10) is a zip of CSV files written by the admin **Research
export** screen or `python -m app.cli export-research`. Every download is audited.

- **Pseudonymous.** People appear only by their random `pseudonym_code`. Groups,
  families, sessions, lessons and homework appear by keyed codes (an HMAC of the
  internal id). The codes stay the same across exports and cannot be reversed without
  the server key. No names, usernames, labels or free text are exported.
- **Separate files for adolescents and caregivers** (`adolescent/`, `caregiver/`).
  `shared/` holds group, family and session tables with no per-person values.
- **Consent (D32, D81).** A participant's record is exported only if it was made
  while their research-export consent was on.
- **Dates (D82).** Each row has a calendar date in the site time zone and a study day
  (day 1 = the day the account was created). No time of day is exported.
- Demo groups, families and accounts are left out unless the export includes demo data.
- Lists are `;`-separated. Empty cells mean no value.

Column types: `code` (pseudonymous code), `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `int`, `number`,
`bool` (True/False), `text-enum` (one value from a fixed set), `list`, `json`.

## `shared/`

### `shared/groups.csv`

One row per group.

Source: Group, GroupTherapist, Family.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `group_code` | code | Keyed code of the group. |
| `diary_days_per_week` | int | Diary expectation, days per week (D70). |
| `family_count` | int | Families in the group. |
| `therapist_codes` | list | Therapists of the group (pseudonym codes). |
| `created_date` | date | Group created. |

### `shared/families.csv`

One row per family.

Source: Family, FamilyMember.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `family_code` | code | Keyed code of the family. |
| `group_code` | code | Keyed code of the group. |
| `adolescents_exported` | int | Adolescents of this family in the export. |
| `caregivers_exported` | int | Caregivers of this family in the export. |
| `created_date` | date | Family created. |

## Event types (`events.csv`, `event_types.csv`)

| Event | Properties | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `login_success` | — | Successful sign-in. |
| `login_failure` | — | Failed sign-in (subject empty when the username is unknown). |
| `enrolment.code_issued` | `role`, `purpose`, `family` | A one-time code was issued by staff. |
| `enrolment.code_redeemed` | `purpose` | A one-time code was redeemed. |
| `enrolment.onboarded` | — | The participant finished onboarding consent. |
| `joint.invited` | `session`, `episode` | Invited to a joint session. |
| `joint.response` | `session`, `response` | Answered a joint invitation. |
| `joint.join` | `session`, `location` | Joined a room; location is self-reported (hospital/remote) or empty. |
| `joint.started` | `session`, `mode` | Room started (both ready). |
| `joint.pause` | `session`, `by` | Room paused; by = participant/disconnect/therapist/safety. |
| `joint.finished` | `session`, `status`, `reason`, `steps_done`, `steps_skipped` | Room completed or ended early. |
| `joint.leave` | `session` | A participant left, ending the room. |
| `joint.skip` | `session`, `step_type` | A participant skipped a step. |
| `joint.hint` | `session`, `step_type` | A participant asked for a hint. |
| `joint.stop` | `session`, `step_type` | A participant selected "I need to stop". |
| `joint.solo_started` | `session` | A participant started a solo rehearsal. |
| `joint.latency` | `session`, `ms`, `action` | Server time to apply a room action, in ms. |
| `joint.rtt` | `session`, `ms` | Client-measured round trip to the room, in ms. |
| `client.error` | `kind`, `area` | A client-side error: kind = js/api_5xx/network; area = screen key. |
| `task.outcome` | `task`, `outcome` | A scripted task ended: outcome = success/abandoned. |
